glosses: coatrack, hallstand (piece of furniture on which clothes may be hung)
cloakroom (room in a public building where clothes may be stored)
dressing room (room in a theatre where actors change costume)

examples.text: Mein Mantel ist in der Garderobe.
examples.en: My coat is in the cloakroom.

examples.text: Der Hut hängt an der Garderobe.
examples.en: The hat's hanging on the rack.

examples.text: Gibst du deine Jacke an der Garderobe ab?
examples.en: Are you going to leave your jacket in the cloakroom?

examples.text: Mein Mantel hängt in der Garderobe.
examples.en: My coat is in the cloakroom.

examples.text: Ich hole unsere Mäntel an der Garderobe ab.
examples.en: I'll get our coats from the cloakroom.
